name: Termux
shortDescription: A terminal emulator and Linux environment for Android with package management and command-line tools.
description: Termux is an open-source Android terminal emulator that provides a Linux-like environment without requiring root access. It supports package management through APT, shell scripting, programming languages, command-line utilities and Linux workflows.
features: No root required for basic usage
safetyNote: Download Termux from official project sources. Review package permissions and install only trusted packages.

name: Dolphy
shortDescription: An Android multi-tool for wireless protocol research, cybersecurity testing and hardware emulation.
description: Dolphy is an Android multi-tool designed for wireless protocol research, cybersecurity education and hardware emulation. It supports Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, NFC, infrared and Shizuku integration. Its capabilities depend on device hardware, Android compatibility and configuration.
features: Works without root for supported features
safetyNote: Use wireless testing features only on devices and networks you own or have permission to test. Some features require compatible hardware or Shizuku.

name: Spam SMS
shortDescription: An Android SMS testing application designed for authorized message delivery tests.
description: Spam SMS is described as an Android application for sending multiple text messages. It may be used for controlled SMS delivery testing with consenting recipients. Its compatibility and functionality depend on the application and supported messaging services.
safetyNote: Use only with consenting recipients and authorized testing environments. Do not send unsolicited messages or flood phone numbers with messages.

name: Sketchware Pro
shortDescription: A visual Android development environment for building applications using blocks, Java code and XML editing.
description: Sketchware Pro is a community-developed Android application development environment that allows users to build Android applications directly from their phones. It combines visual block programming with Java code editing, XML layout editing, project management and additional development tools.
safetyNote: Download from the official GitHub project. Back up your projects before updating and review APK permissions before installation.

name: Godot Engine
shortDescription: An open-source game engine for creating and developing 2D and 3D games directly on Android.
description: Godot Engine is a free and open-source game development engine. Its Android Editor allows developers to create, edit, test and export 2D and 3D game projects directly from Android devices. It includes scene-based editing, scripting tools and game development features.
features: Run and test projects on Android
safetyNote: The Android editor is experimental and its interface is not fully optimized for touch screens. A physical keyboard and mouse are recommended. C# support is unavailable in the Android editor. Check device compatibility before installation.

name: HappyMod
shortDescription: An Android platform for discovering community-created application and game modifications.
description: HappyMod is a platform for browsing community-created modifications of Android games and applications. Users can explore available versions, descriptions and compatibility information. Modified APK files may introduce security, privacy and account risks.
safetyNote: Modified APK files may contain malicious code or request excessive permissions. Scan files before installation and avoid modifications that bypass payment or security protections.

name: RS Cookies
shortDescription: An Android tool for inspecting and extracting cookies from data you own or are authorized to test.
description: RS Cookies is an Android application described as a cookie extraction and inspection tool. It is intended for authorized security research and testing of cookie data belonging to the user or systems for which permission has been granted. Its compatibility and technical requirements should be verified before use.
safetyNote: Cookies may contain active authentication sessions and sensitive information. Never extract, share or use cookies belonging to other people or accounts without explicit authorization. Protect extracted data and delete it when no longer needed.

name: Kali NetHunter
shortDescription: A mobile penetration testing platform for Android based on Kali Linux.
description: Kali NetHunter is a mobile penetration testing platform based on Kali Linux. It provides cybersecurity tools and capabilities for ethical hacking, network security research, Linux workflows and mobile penetration testing on compatible Android devices.
features: Root and non-root deployment options depending on edition
safetyNote: Some features require root access, compatible hardware or additional components. Use penetration testing tools only on systems you own or have explicit permission to test.

name: NetHunter KeX
shortDescription: An Android client for accessing a graphical Kali Linux desktop environment.
description: NetHunter KeX provides a graphical desktop interface for Kali NetHunter. It allows users to connect to a configured Kali Linux desktop environment from a compatible Android device and use graphical Linux applications remotely.
safetyNote: Requires a compatible and configured Kali NetHunter environment. Protect remote desktop credentials and connect only to systems you are authorized to access.

name: Lucky Patcher
shortDescription: An Android application management and modification tool with backup and patching capabilities.
description: Lucky Patcher is an Android application modification tool that offers application backup, supported patching operations and application management features. Some functionality requires root access, and compatibility varies depending on the Android version and application. Certain modifications may bypass licensing or payment protections and should not be used without authorization.
safetyNote: Application modification can cause instability and security issues. Verify the installer, scan the APK and back up important data. Do not bypass licensing, payments or security protections.

name: Bluetooth File Transfer
shortDescription: An Android application for transferring files and selected contacts between compatible Bluetooth devices.
description: Bluetooth File Transfer by Medieval Software allows users to browse supported files on compatible Bluetooth devices, transfer files and share selected contacts. Functionality depends on Bluetooth compatibility, Android permissions and device configuration.
safetyNote: Pair only with trusted devices. Contact sharing requires appropriate permissions and the consent of the person whose information is shared.

name: Magisk
shortDescription: An open-source Android rooting solution with systemless modifications and module support.
description: Magisk is an open-source Android rooting solution that provides systemless modifications, root permission management and support for modules that customize device functionality. Installation methods and compatibility depend on the device and Android version.
safetyNote: Rooting can reduce device security, affect banking applications and cause boot problems. Verify device compatibility and back up important data before installation.

name: Third Eye - Smart Video Recorder
shortDescription: An Android video recording application that supports recording while the screen is off.
description: Third Eye is an Android video recording application that supports recording with the screen turned off. It offers front and rear camera support, multiple video resolutions and recording status notifications. Camera and microphone permissions should be used responsibly.
safetyNote: Use camera and microphone permissions responsibly. Obtain consent before recording people and comply with local privacy and recording laws.
